translation.name: Godɨn Eghaghanim: Akar Gavgavir Dɨkɨrɨzir Ghurim ko Igiam

book.name: Onger Akaba
book.title: Godɨn Ziam Fer Onger Akabar Akɨnafarim O Onger Akaba

content: Kar onger akar kabar faragha zuir gumazimɨn onger akam.A gumazamizibav kemezɨ me Mahalatɨn tiarimɨn ighiar kam bange.
Me onger akar kam kamagh a dɨbori, Maskil.

content.text: Gumazamizir onganiba uan navir averiabar aven nɨghnɨgha ghaze, “God itir puvatɨ.”
Gumazamizir kaba me bar gumazamizir kurabara.
Me bar moghɨra arazir aghuitam gamir puvatɨ.
God uan Nguibamɨn pɨn ikia nguazimɨn itir gumazamizibar gari,
men tav ti nɨghnɨzir aghuim ikia a gɨfofoghasa a buri,
ti puvatɨ.
Me bar tuavir aghuim ataki.
Me bar moghɨra ikuvigha magh gari.
Men tav arazir aghuitam bar a gamizir pu.
Bar puvatɨ.
God kamaghɨn mɨgɨa ghaze,
“Gumazamizir arazir kuram gamiba, nɨghnɨzir aghuitam men itir puvatɨ.
Me bret apava anegevi moghɨn, me nan gumazamiziba a gefi.
Egha me tong na ko mɨgeir puvatɨ.”
Gumazamizir kamaghɨn amiba atiatir bar dafam me bativam.
Fomɨra atiatir kamaghɨn garitam me batozir puvatɨ.
Guizbangɨra, God bar uan gumazamizibar apanibar aghua.
Me ariaghirezɨ, a men aghariba tintinibar da kavkɨnizɨ, da irezɨ, me bar aghumsɨki.
Kamaghɨn, a bar me gafiragha gɨfa.
Kɨ kamaghɨn ifonge, Israelian akurvaghamin gumazitam Saionɨn nguibamɨn ikegh azenan izɨ.
God uan gumazamizibar akuraghtɨ me deravɨra ikɨtɨ, Jekopɨn ovaviba bar akuegham.
Guizbangɨra, Israelian naviba deragham.
